units.source_text: 且说小野草庵中，浮舟面对绿树丛生的青山，正在寂寞无聊地望着池塘上的飞萤，回思往事，借以慰情。

en.t: Meanwhile, in the little thatched hermitage at Ono, Ukifune sat facing the green, wooded hills, gazing in lonely idleness at the fireflies over the pond and consoling herself by thinking back on the past.

units.source_text: 忽然那遥远的山谷之间传来一片威势十足的开路喝道之声，又望见参参差差的许多火把的光焰。

en.t: Suddenly, from the distant valley, there came the commanding shouts of men clearing the way, and she could see the uneven flames of many torches.

units.source_text: 那些尼僧便走出檐前来看，其中一人说道：“不知道是谁下山来，随从人员多得很呢。

en.t: The nuns went out beneath the eaves to look, and one of them said, "I wonder who is coming down the mountain; there are so many attendants with him.

units.source_text: 昼间送干海藻到僧都那里去，回信中说大将在横川，他正忙于招待，送去的海藻正用得着呢。”

en.t: When we sent dried seaweed to the bishop during the day, his reply said that the General was at Yokawa, that he was busy entertaining him, and that the seaweed we sent would be just what he needed."

units.source_text: 另一尼僧说：“他所说的大将，就是二公主的驸马么？”

en.t: Another nun said, "By the General he mentioned, does he mean the husband of the Second Princess?"

units.source_text: 这正是穷乡僻壤的田舍人口气。

en.t: It was just the sort of way people from a remote country place would speak.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“恐怕确是他了。

en.t: Ukifune thought, "It is probably him after all.

units.source_text: 从前他常走这山路到宇治山庄来，我听得出几个很熟的随从人员的声音，分明夹杂在里头。

en.t: In the past he often came along this mountain road to the villa at Uji, and I can hear the voices of several attendants I know very well clearly mixed in among them.

units.source_text: 许多日月过去了，从前的事还不能忘记。

en.t: So many months and years have passed, yet I still cannot forget what happened long ago.
But what meaning can any of it have now?"

units.source_text: 她觉得伤心，便念阿弥陀佛，借以遣怀，越发沉默不语了。

en.t: Feeling sorrowful, she recited the name of Amida Buddha to distract her heart, and grew even more silent.

units.source_text: 这小野地方，只有赴横川去的人才经过。

en.t: This place called Ono was passed only by people on their way to Yokawa.

units.source_text: 这里的人只有见人经过时才听见些浮世的声息。

en.t: The people who lived here heard a little of the outside world only when travelers passed by.

units.source_text: 薰大将本想就在此时派小君前往，但念人目众多，殊属不便，就决定明日再派小君来此。

en.t: General Kaoru had intended to send Kogimi there at once, but since there were too many eyes upon him and it would be very inconvenient, he decided to send Kogimi the next day instead.
